title: Helm: private-values init hooks - validate schema, backward-compatible templating, and init job lifecycle improvements
author: Leah Morgan
description: Motivation: private deployments (VPC/on-prem) rely on a loosely validated values.yaml; misconfigured init hooks or unexpected value shapes have caused upgrade failures and stuck init jobs during recent customer rollouts. This PR adds a formal JSON Schema for charts/redwood-private values (v2 schema) with a backwards-compatible migration path, strengthens templating to tolerate missing/legacy keys, and improves init hook lifecycle handling so failed validation does not leave pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Changes include: 1) values.schema.json describing required top-level keys, allowed types, and deprecated keys with guidance; 2) a pre-upgrade validate hook job that runs schema validation using kubeval + a small bootstrap container that can read both v1 and v2 shapes; 3) templating helpers to fall back to legacy fields when present and render clear warnings in NOTES.txt; 4) updates to init-job.yaml to use Kubernetes Job TTL controller and explicit backoffLimit so failed validation runs expire and surface clear error messages to the operator; 5) README and migration notes with example upgrade commands and an automated migration snippet for common cases. Backwards-compatibility: default values and templating helpers ensure existing values.yaml remain valid; the schema is opt-in by toggling values.validateSchema=true (default off) to allow staged rollouts. Testing: unit-tested templates with helm unittest, added chart assertions for schema acceptance, integration test added to the CI helm-upgrade pipeline to validate a staged upgrade from v1->v2. Rollback notes: validation is gated behind the flag and validation job will be skipped on rollback if flag not set. See related PRs pr-18902, pr-19321 for previous init hook iterations. Checklist: - [x] add values.schema.json and schema-driven validate job - [x] fallback helpers for legacy keys - [x] helm unittest cases - [x] integration test in CI - [x] docs and upgrade notes - [x] manual validation against a private VPC test cluster

fix: init-job ttl and backoffLimit to avoid stuck pods

review_comments: Diego Alvarez (2026-02-16): Overall looks good. Please ensure the schema remains optional by default as discussed in ENG-3421. Also prefer kubeconform over kubeval in the image if it reduces false positives.

Leah Morgan (2026-02-16): Thanks Diego — made validateSchema=false by default and added a note about kubeconform vs kubeval; left kubeval in the container image for now because it matches our integration environment, will follow up with an image swap in a follow-up PR.

Priya Shah (2026-02-18): The backoffLimit/ttl changes seem correct, but can we add one integration run that simulates a malformed legacy values.yaml to confirm the helper fallbacks produce a clear NOTES message?
Leah Morgan (2026-02-18): Added helm-unittest case for malformed legacy values and updated NOTES.txt to include explicit remediation commands.

Michael Turner (2026-02-20): CI integration test initially timed out on helm-upgrade stage; looks like the job waits on CRs that are not ready in the cluster image. Recommend reusing the test cluster snapshot used by perf-canary to avoid flakiness.
Leah Morgan (2026-02-21): Switched the integration job to use the perf-canary snapshot and increased the helm-upgrade timeout; reran pipeline and all checks passed.
release_notes: Adds optional schema validation for redwood-private Helm values, pre-upgrade validation hook, legacy-compatible templating helpers, and safer init job lifecycle settings. Schema is opt-in via values.validateSchema=false by default to allow staged rollouts. Includes docs and migration guidance.
files_snippets: values.schema.json: added definitions for networking.vpcId (string), storage.size (string|number), init.enabled (boolean, deprecated: init_job.enabled), deprecatedKeys: [init_job]
_helpers.tpl: added tpl functions getLegacy / legacyOrDefault and warning helper for NOTES.txt
validate-schema-job.yaml: Job uses image redwood/kubeval:0.16, mounts values.yaml via configmap and exits non-zero on schema failures with useful error logs
notes_for_ops: Enable schema validation on a single test release by setting --set validateSchema=true during helm upgrade; if validation fails, the job will create a short-lived job with logs in the job pod; remediation steps are in charts/redwood-private/README.md. For automated upgrades, set validateSchema=true only after running migration snippet or running the migration job separately.
changelog_entry: chart(redwood-private): optional values schema + init-hook validation (opt-in, non-breaking)
